description:
Parent: fz-kdt

Found by cold design review (2026-08-29). fact-engine.md states 'a rebased
job's next conclusion replaces its cumulative store values instead of joining
(the only narrowing path)'. But world.rs:634 reads

    let preserve_frontier = rebased || matches!(job, Job::AnalyzeActivation(_))

and the else branch at world.rs:642-645 passes literal false for rebased --
so ContributionMap::conclude's narrowing path (semantic.rs:1032-1055) is
UNREACHABLE for activation inputs: ActivationInputs joins unconditionally,
while ReturnType does narrow on rebase (semantic.rs:929-937). Over-wide input
evidence survives a ground shift: sound but permanently imprecise, and a
latent trap for anything that reasons about narrowing (e.g. specialization
width, fz-y6w's collapsed fanout).

Fix: decide which is right -- either activation inputs get a real narrowing
path on rebase (and the matches! special case is deleted), or the doc is
corrected to state the exception and WHY. Measure specialization counts
before/after if narrowing is enabled (lowering pins is safe-by-construction;
check output correctness only).

## CANNOT be dissolved via fz-kdt.69.3 (2026-08-30)

The planned dissolution (ActivationInputs rows derived from live edges, no
join-vs-replace question) is refuted: the edge fact is a strict subset of
stated demand (fz-kdt.80) and cannot carry the correlated row model
(fz-kdt.81), so the preserve_frontier special case remains load-bearing.
This ticket needs its own decision, gated on fz-kdt.82 (a withdrawal that
propagates as an ascent is the soundness trap either resolution must not
open).
title: ReturnType narrows on rebase but ActivationInputs cannot: code contradicts fact-engine.md
